title: Mouse Control Tool — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Performs clicks, pointer movement, and scrolling with precision. The Mouse Control Tool moves the pointer, clicks, double-clicks, right-clicks, drags, and scrolls inside authorized applications. Movements can target absolute screen coordinates or named interface elements found by the screen recognition tool. Every action is logged with its coordinates for audit.
capabilities: Move pointer to coordinates or named elements
Left, right, middle, double, and long-press clicks
Drag-and-drop with path waypoints
Scroll by lines, pages, or pixels
Coordinate audit log for every action
